moments.title: Lionesses World Cup Play-Off
moments.blurb: England Women kick off their FIFA World Cup play-off semi-final first leg against Greece in Crete on Friday, aiming for a spot in next year's tournament.

angles.name: Game Day Buzz
angles.copy: Huge night for the Lionesses! They're in Crete taking on Greece in their World Cup play-off first leg. Kick-off is 5:30pm – come on England!

angles.name: Road to World Cup
angles.copy: The journey to the Women's World Cup continues! England face Greece in the first leg of their play-off semi-final tonight. Can they get a crucial away goal?

moments.title: Premier League Returns
moments.blurb: After the international break, the Premier League is set to resume this weekend, bringing top-flight club football back to the UK.

angles.name: Club Football Back
angles.copy: No more international break! Club football is back this weekend, and we're ready for all the Premier League action. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Weekend Anticipation
angles.copy: That Friday feeling just got better! The Premier League returns this weekend, so get ready for your favourite teams to battle it out.

moments.title: Taylor Swift Dominates UK Chart
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' has debuted at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of October 2-8, 2026, with two other new entries in the Top 5.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: She's done it again! Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' is the new UK Number 1 single. An instant smash!

angles.name: Swiftie Power
angles.copy: Three new Taylor Swift tracks in the Top 5 this week! The Swifties have spoken – 'Patient Zero' takes the top spot. Incredible.

moments.title: The Party Premieres on ITVX

angles.name: Weekend Binge
angles.copy: Your next must-watch drama drops this Sunday! 'The Party', starring Luke Evans and Sarah Solemani, lands on ITVX. Get ready to binge.

angles.name: New British Drama
angles.copy: Based on a best-selling novel, 'The Party' looks like gripping viewing. It's new to ITVX this Sunday – perfect for a cosy night in.

moments.title: UK Autumn Weather Update
moments.blurb: The UK is experiencing a transition to more autumnal weather this week, with an increased risk of wet and windy conditions expected later in October, though the start of the month has been dry.

angles.name: Autumn Vibes
angles.copy: It's officially feeling much more autumnal across the UK this week! Get ready for those crisp mornings and maybe a bit more rain later in the month.

angles.name: Weather Watch
angles.copy: The Met Office is forecasting a wetter and windier October overall, but with a dry start to the month. Time to dig out those jumpers!
